checked: The original action is reduced once before progress starts; the pending result is reused for No and save retries.

Yes creates a contextual event against the prepared state, requires nonempty actions and actual post-action state effect, and saves original action plus event before publishing.

resolvedFindings.trigger: In 3D mode, enter a room or ride transit; accept the optional event and save successfully.
resolvedFindings.behavior: The phase watcher changes reading mode to compact to reveal the saved event, but the originating async handler resumes after runInteraction and sets reading mode back to hidden. This hides the event the player just requested.
resolvedFindings.evidence: publishInteraction sets reactive state and interaction=null before resolving the awaited interaction Promise. The queued Vue watcher runs before the originating async runInteraction continuation. Both 3D transition continuations unconditionally request hidden mode.
resolvedFindings.suggestion: Have transition completion preserve compact mode when a new event story was saved, while retaining the existing No/no-event scene behavior.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Transition handlers compare latest assistant ID before/after interaction, retain compact mode for a saved event and avoid scene refocus; overlay captures focus from its persistent anchor shadow root without cross-realm instanceof.

resolvedFindings.behavior: Focus capture does not reliably find the triggering control in the shadow-root shell hosted by a separate helper iframe. Before v-if mounting, dialog.value is absent and global document may be the helper document. ownerDocument.activeElement would identify the shadow host rather than its active control; a cross-realm HTMLElement check can also reject the parent element.
resolvedFindings.suggestion: Capture focus from the actual shell shadow root using its owner document, and avoid a global realm-dependent instanceof check.
resolvedFindings.limit: This is a focus restoration defect; no definite keyboard lock or transaction correctness failure was identified.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Persistent anchor obtains shadow-root activeElement and checks focus method without realm-specific instanceof; saved event deliberately skips restoring old button focus.
